history.content: I want to improve biodiversity around this location: 19.076, 72.8777. Based on the soil and land-cover conditions, what interventions should I prioritize, and how could they affect soil health, habitat quality, and biodiversity over time?

Establish localized green spaces, hedgerows, and buffer strips utilizing native vegetation, alongside the addition of organic amendments and cover plantings to enhance soil organic matter and biological activity.
Given those conditions, which intervention should I implement first, and why?
Implement localized green spaces and hedgerows using native vegetation combined with organic amendments and cover plantings, utilizing legumes in the initial phase to improve soil nitrogen status.
What additional environmental data would make your recommendation more reliable?

Integrate localized high-resolution soil testing, real-time sensor data on soil moisture and nutrient dynamics, and fine-scale socio-ecological assessments prior to executing urban greening interventions.
